The data will be saved in a new sub‑directory “oxides_data” inside the current workdir.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>

    "compositions": ["TiO2", "SiO2", "Al2O3", "Fe2O3", "FeO", "MgO", "CaO", "ZnO", "CuO", "NiO", "CoO", "MnO", "Cr2O3", "SnO2", "PbO"],
    "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
    "max_per_composition": 3,
    "save_directory": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/workdir/5/ml_oxides_trial_1/oxides_data"
}</action_input>
